CustomField.description: Development only. Skips the OTP stage so an Emirates ID logs straight in. Has no effect on its own: Dev_Skip_OTP_Org_Id__c must also equal the running org id. Deliberately absent from the Default record in the repo, so deploying that record never turns this on. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Dev Skip OTP
